Vendored browser QR modules (no CDN required):
- qrcode-generator 2.0.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator
- jsQR 1.4.0, Cozmo/jsQR authors, Apache-2.0: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

QR generation and camera-frame decoding happen in the browser. No visitor pass is sent to a third-party QR image API. License files accompany both modules.
